entities.summary: Manuel Alcides Acosta Molinar is a Panamanian former professional baseball pitcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Atlanta Braves and New York Mets, and in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Yomiuri Giants.
